V2.5A Tablet / mobile live combat flow

Live table mode: choose Actor, Target, Action, then Resolve. Tablets use a 2x2 grid by default; phones stack the cards. Use the Layout toggle to force grid or stack if needed.
V2.5A Flow
Recommended table setup: one shared tablet works best because saves are local to this browser. Export a snapshot before updating the GitHub Pages app.

No pending result yet. Pick an actor, target, and action; then enter dice in the roll tray below. Results auto-update.

Mobile flow ready.
How to use this flow
  1. Pick the acting figure.
  2. Tap an already-loaded encounter target card, or switch to Party/Command for support targets.
  3. Tap the action card that matches what the figure is doing.
  4. Enter dice; the result auto-updates. Use Apply pending result from this card or the sticky footer.
Board legality, SOI, adjacency, movement, line of sight, and hidden text stay manual. This view is only a routing/math/bookkeeping layer.

Current tablet recipe

  1. Adventurer attack: Actor → Target + Attack → dice auto-calc → Apply → Chain/Next.
  2. Enemy attack: enemy actor → Enemy Attack → target → defensive tray → Apply → Counter if offered.
  3. Nightingale: Spell / Force opens her spell/familiar panel; Life Grasp and Abbadon use their dedicated helpers.
  4. Loyal Esper: Nightingale → Summon Esper → bridge → summon → Load actor.

10. Probability mode + rerolls

Decision support using the current attacker, target, spell, enemy attack, toggles, manual modifiers, reserves, armor, tracker damage, and selected reroll models. Attack and enemy-attack odds use automatic max-damage symbol spending for each possible roll; FU reserves are still honored.
Reroll modeling options
Reroll scenarios are EV-optimal: the model chooses whether to reroll after seeing the eligible roll, then keeps the rerolled die/dice. It does not enforce whether the card is currently Ready or already Exhausted; use the card-state tracker for that.

4. Party HP / effect tracker

Track adventurer damage, optional SP, Effects, and ability tokens here. This is bookkeeping only: it does not enforce SP costs, Exhaust timing, Per Encounter use, or board legality.
Party tracker ready.
Prepare next encounter removes Effects, preserves Ability tokens, and reduces only defeated or over-half-damaged adventurers to half HP damage. Ability tokens are counted resources and are removed by Restore, spending, or defeat cleanup. Full restore clears all party damage, Effects, and Ability tokens. SP is a manual convenience field and defaults to 3.

V2.1F Command Combatant / Loyal Esper tracker

Rook spell helpers

Zealous Reprisal: damage and Push are reduced by max(0, distance - 1). Load the spell, resolve Force vs Conviction, then apply the spell result to the selected tracked enemy.
Rook passive reminders added in V2.2A
  • Aspect: Rook's Movement is 7 with the current loadout. Movement point cost is not increased by Terrain or allies. This does not grant Flight and the app does not pathfind.
  • Inspiration: when an ally within Rook's SOI ends their turn with 0 SP, confirm SOI and grant that ally +1 SP. Mend grants 3 Heal tokens instead of 2.
  • Proof of Divinity: the +1 SP trigger is once each round and only from another ally with Courage dealing Damage, not Rook himself.

Character stats

Enemy preset

Format: id | source | cost | physical | magic | text. Example: enemy_fragor_burst | Fragor | burst:1 | 1 | 0 | 1 Burst -> +1 Physical Damage

Attack profile

Format: id | color | label, or color | label.
Use this for mandatory black dice or other extra dice.
Format: id | source | cost | physical | magic | text. Cost examples: shield:2, burst:1, book:2.
Advanced profile fields
Leave blank for normal fixed dice. Existing Gigas Grip dice choices are preserved here.

Spell / spell-like preset

Format: key=value. Example: optionalGoreBonus=true or optionalGoreMagic=8.

Effect/token option lists

These lists affect dropdowns only. Existing saved tracker tokens/effects are not automatically removed unless you reset or manually remove them.
